finding: ManagedPythonInstallations.init migrates an existing sibling toolchains directory into the selected absent Python root and creates a symlink at the previous path; migration does not verify Python contents.
offline_regression: uv --offline --no-config python install --no-python-downloads 3.12.12 calls init before refusing missing Python downloads; python dir does not call init and is unsuitable.
proposed_isolation: Use /opt/ipfs-supervisor/python-runtime/python for both uv python install and uv venv, keeping the shipped /opt/ipfs-supervisor/toolchains outside that parent.
scope: Source review only; no binary download, installation, model work or trial performed by reviewer.
